cohort: The study included 138 Maya children aged 6 years old (72 urban and 66 rural) in Yucatan, Mexico.
finding: Urbanization and household crowding were the most powerful predictors of anthropometry in 6-year-old Maya children.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in boys than girls and predicted increased height in urban boys.
birth_weight: Measured but specific values not reported
